summary: Local coverage is thin; complaints found centre on waterlogging and drainage, sugarcane dues and waste from illegal slaughterhouses in the Kharkhauda area, while the appreciated items are mostly district-level health and flood-protection works.

positives.english: Ganga embankment built by the Irrigation Department has protected crops in more than a dozen villages from flooding
positives.hindi: *गंगा किनारे बने तटबंध से एक दर्जन से अधिक गांवों की फसलें बाढ़ से बची
positives.basis: Inference: source is a Meerut district report on the Machhra and Rajpura block area, not a Kithore-specific one. Farmers said the Irrigation Department embankment along the Ganga protected crops in more than a dozen villages from flooding. AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: Drain and CC road work on Ikdi Road is finished and the waterlogging problem was not found on inspection
positives.hindi: *ईकड़ी रोड पर नाले और सीसी सड़क का काम पूरा हुआ, जलभराव नहीं मिला
positives.basis: Inference: Meerut district report with a Sardhana dateline about Ikdi Road, a Kanwar route. It does not name Kithore, Kharkhauda, Machhra, Rajpura or Mawana. Officials said the drain and road work is complete and an inspection found no waterlogging. AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: Pathology lab has started in the new building of the Sarurpur CHC so patients get tests locally
positives.hindi: *सरूरपुर सीएचसी के नए भवन में पैथोलॉजी लैब शुरू, मरीजों को राहत
positives.basis: Inference: the CHC is in Sarurpur (Meerut district, dateline Sarurpur), which the article does not link to Kithore. The article says the lab has started and that patients in the area will get relief. AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: Groundbreaking done for a new cancer screening centre building at the Police Line urban health centre in Meerut
positives.hindi: *मेरठ पुलिस लाइन में कैंसर स्क्रीनिंग सेंटर के नए भवन का भूमि पूजन हुआ
positives.basis: Inference: Meerut city (Police Line urban PHC), not Kithore. Source says the bhoomi pujan was held and officials expect better early cancer screening. Not a completed benefit. AC membership not applicable.

positives.english: Sugarcane crop has so far not suffered major damage from the recent rain and hail
positives.hindi: *बारिश और ओलों से गन्ने की फसल को फिलहाल खास नुकसान नहीं
positives.basis: Inference: same Meerut district report on the Machhra and Rajpura area. The article says sugarcane has so far not suffered major damage. This is relief from a risk, not a delivered benefit, so it is the weakest positive. AC membership unconfirmed.

negatives.english: Rain water stands in fields in Machhra and cut paddy is floating in it
negatives.hindi: बारिश का पानी खेतों में भरा है, कटी धान पानी में तैर रही है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Meerut report: after rain and hail, cut and standing paddy was submerged in water in Machhra; farmers fear waterlogging will lower crop quality. The article places this in the Machhra and Rajpura blocks. Wikipedia's Kithore extent lists KC Machhara, but the block is not confirmed to be the same as the AC. AC membership unconfirmed.

negatives.english: Pending sugarcane dues are not being paid on time and farmers are angry
negatives.hindi: *गन्ने का बकाया भुगतान समय पर नहीं मिल रहा, किसान नाराज़ हैं
negatives.basis: Inference: Meerut district-level report. BKU's protest at Meerut Commissioner's Chowk demanded timely payment of pending sugarcane dues, a fair cane price, power and fertiliser supply. No Kithore or Kharkhauda mill or dues figure was found. The article gives no dues amount.

negatives.english: Allegedly, waste from illegal slaughterhouses flows into the Kali river
negatives.hindi: अवैध बूचड़खानों का गंदा पानी कली नदी में जाने का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Swarajya ground report, dated 2019-02-02 (old; not 2024-2026). Residents of Kharkhauda villages (Kaul, Allipur, Setkuan, Peepli Kheda, Bijauli, Bahrampur, Khaspur, Aadh) allege that slaughterhouse waste goes into drains and reaches the Kali Nadi. Kharkhauda nagar panchayat and KC Kharkhauda are in the AC per Wikipedia, but these named villages are not confirmed inside the AC, so the count below is 0. Allegations stay as allegations.

negatives.english: Hand-pump water in some villages is discoloured and looks like sugarcane juice, allegedly
negatives.hindi: कुछ हैंडपंपों का पानी गन्ने के रस जैसा रंगीन निकलने का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Same 2019 Swarajya ground report on Kharkhauda villages. Residents say hand-pump water is so discoloured that one sample resembled sugarcane juice. The government stopped installing hand-pumps and one village gets a water tank supply about once a week. Old source; AC membership of the named villages unconfirmed.

negatives.english: Residents allege that cancer cases are rising near the slaughterhouse discharge area of Kharkhauda
negatives.hindi: आरोप है कि खरखौदा के आसपास के गांवों में कैंसर के मामले बढ़े हैं
negatives.basis: Same 2019 Swarajya report. Residents claim cancer is increasingly common and that at least 40 people died of cancer in nearby villages in the past year. This is an unverified allegation from residents, not a medical finding. Old source; AC membership of the named villages unconfirmed.

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia list (No. 46 Kithore, Meerut district, General/None). Kithore extent per Wikipedia: KC Machhara and Kithore NP of Mawana tehsil; KCs Rajpura, Kharkhauda and Kharkhauda NP of Meerut tehsil. Villages are not listed. Kithore's current MLA is Shahid Manzoor (SP, 2022). Local coverage was very thin: about 30 Hindi and English searches found no 2024-2026 article naming Kithore, Kithore NP, Kharkhauda or Machhara for a civic problem. Negatives 3 and 4 and 5 rely on one 2019 report and are not AC-confirmed. Positives 2-5 are Meerut district items with no AC link and are flagged as inference. Positive 5 is relief from a risk, not a benefit, and is the weakest item. Excluded: ETV Bharat tourism review of a Ramlila ground in Kithore (a review, not a delivered project); Hastinapur erosion (another AC); Sivalkhas and Sambhal items; Grokipedia and other aggregator pages. Field check recommended: Kithore NP drainage and garbage, Kharkhauda sugar mill dues, Kali Nadi condition, and the Kithore police station area.
